issues.description: Regression introduced by the AC8 change. On phones the name now shares its row with the icon and with the pin, which the global touch-target rule (src/app/app-theme.css:1540, icon buttons min 48×48 on phones) makes 48 px wide; the name column shrinks from the full header width (170/210/225/240 px at 320/360/375/390 px on master) to 90/130/145/160 px, and `break-words` (line 668) then cuts ordinary words mid-word. Measured on the stand, branch vs the previous layout (same page with the group dissolved): 320 px — 19 words split across 35 cards vs 1, including the demo seed «Кафе «Ромашка»» → «Кафе / «Ромашка / »», «Поликлиника», and 4 of 6 typical names («Производственный», «Кондитерский», «Центральная», «Берёзка») vs 0; 360/375/390 px (most phones) — «Производственный цех №2» renders «Производственны / й цех №2» vs intact before; 412/430 px — none. AC8 asks that the long name wrap inside the row; cutting short or domain-typical words is a new visible defect in the exact card and widths AC8 governs (master had none for these names).
issues.repro: next dev :3000; as admin@haccp.local open /settings/buildings at 390×900 with a point named «Производственный цех №2» (or 320×900 and the seed card «Кафе «Ромашка»»): the first word is split across lines. Scripted: node .agent/tasks/old-minor-fixes-2026-11-25/raw/verifier-round1/stand/ac8-typical-names.mjs <outdir> (env loaded) — prints broken words per width for the branch and the previous layout; screenshots raw/verifier-round1/stand/screens/ac8-typical-production-390-branch.png, ac8-real-romashka-320-branch.png vs ac8-real-romashka-320-previous-simulated.png.

issues.description: Pre-existing, outside the spec: the automation lock takes «today» from getStartOfToday (UTC hours) while todayKey and the past-days window use the organization's timezone, so from 00:00 to 03:00 Moscow time the Moscow «yesterday» row of an automation document is not locked at all. Seen while building the AC1 stand (run at 00:11 MSK), worked around by testing «2 days ago».
issues.repro: At 21:00–24:00 UTC, automation doc, no window: DELETE {employeeId, date: <Moscow yesterday>} → 200 instead of 403.
